info.title: TucanoTime API
info.description: Timesheet system: daily/weekly time entries, customers and project codes with per-entity currencies and hourly rates. File-backed (no database); the API is the only writer below TUCANO_DATA_DIR. Access is private-per-user: a member sees and edits only their own entries/expenses/submissions; an administrator sees all data and owns invoicing, approvals and user management (the /api/users and /api/invoices routes return 403 for members). Mutating endpoints may return 503 (Retry-After) under write contention. Mutating requests (POST/PUT/DELETE) must also carry the X-CSRF-Protection: 1 header; without it the request is rejected 403 with code csrf. Exempt: POST /api/auth/login, /api/auth/bootstrap, /api/auth/sso/assertion.

cookieAuth.name: tt_session
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly session cookie issued by /api/auth/login or /api/auth/bootstrap.

message.description: Human-readable; never contains paths, stack traces or raw filesystem errors.

fingerprint.description: sha256: plus the first four bytes of the key hash in lowercase hex. Safe to display; never the key itself.

key_file_name.description: The fixed literal vault.key when the managed key file is in use; null otherwise. Never a host path.

external_override.description: TUCANO_SECRET_KEY or TUCANO_SECRET_KEY_FILE is configured; the key is operator-managed out-of-band.

created_key.description: Only on enable/regenerate responses: true when a new key file was minted, false when an existing key was reused.

ProjectCode.description: Normalised upper case; letters and digits, dashes and underscores after the first character; at most 24 characters.

Hours.description: Hours as a decimal with at most two fractional digits (0.01–24.00). Stored as integer hundredths.

RateMinor.description: Hourly rate in currency minor units (cents). 6000 = 60.00.

invoice_prefix.description: Optional uppercase invoice prefix. Empty prefixes are omitted. Future drafts use PREFIX-001; existing numbers never change. Identical prefixes share a durable sequence. INV is reserved for default numbering.

email.description: Optional billing email for invoice delivery

payment_terms.description: Payment terms for the issue-time due date.

invoice_notes.description: Markdown-subset notes appended to this customer's invoice documents.

contacts.description: Billing contacts. When a contact is flagged billing, invoice emails go there.

tax_hundredths.description: Default VAT in hundredths of a percent (2100 = 21.00%). Integer, never float.

payment_details.description: Company payment details configured for this customer — the "Get paid" answer: rendered in the GUI panel, mailed as "How to pay", printed on documents. Absent when unset; settlement stays manual.

legal_id.description: The customer's company/registration number printed on invoice documents (e.g. 99999999). Empty on legacy documents.

invoice_prefix.description: Optional invoice prefix: 1–20 ASCII letters/digits/internal hyphens after trimming spaces, removing trailing hyphens and uppercasing. Must begin with a letter/digit. Control characters and INV are rejected. Empty string clears the prefix; omission/null preserves it on PUT and uses default INV numbering on POST. Custom prefixes use PREFIX-001.

payment_terms.description: Payment terms for the issue-time due date.

invoice_notes.description: Markdown-subset notes appended to this customer's invoice documents.

contacts.description: Billing contacts. When a contact is flagged billing, invoice emails go there.

tax_hundredths.description: Default VAT in hundredths of a percent (2100 = 21.00%). Integer, never float.

payment_details.description: Company payment details configured for this customer — the "Get paid" answer: rendered in the GUI panel, mailed as "How to pay", printed on documents. Absent when unset; settlement stays manual.

legal_id.description: The customer's company/registration number printed on invoice documents (e.g. 99999999). Defaults empty.

budget_hours.description: Total budget in hundredths of an hour; bounded by the field maximum

Task.description: A task under a project. Tasks have no billing overrides; legacy stored currency/rate fields are ignored.

TaskInput.description: Task billing overrides are not supported. currency and rate_minor are rejected as unknown fields.

user_id.description: The user who logged the entry (attribution).

billable.description: Billable vs non-billable time. Non-billable time is never invoiced.

source.description: Provenance. Server-set; API clients create manual entries.

InvoiceStatus.description: Invoice lifecycle; partly_paid and written_off are included.

quantity_hundredths.description: Manual lines: hundredths of a unit.

InvoiceDocument.description: Optional invoice document overrides (contract revision 0.1.48). Omitted/null overrides inherit existing customer/template defaults; empty notes explicitly suppress default notes. Old payloads remain valid. Issued documents cannot be edited.

supersedes.description: Set on a correction revision: the invoice it supersedes.

superseded_by.description: Set on a superseded original: the active correction revision. History only; excluded from active aggregates.

payments.description: Payment ledger. A legacy paid document without entries counts as fully paid.

subject.description: The resolved invoice subject, frozen at issue (interpolated from the customer/template). Empty on drafts and legacy issued documents.

terms.description: The payment terms used to resolve due_date at issue, frozen so a document prints (Net N) from its own snapshot. Absent when the legacy net-14 fallback applied or on legacy documents.

outstanding.description: Outstanding BALANCES keyed by currency (total - paid over issued/partly_paid).

partly_paid.description: Open invoices with a partially settled balance.

include_expenses.description: Roll billable expenses into the invoice.

project_codes.description: Restrict billing to these projects of the customer; empty = all eligible projects.

InvoiceInput.description: Generate a draft from a period's billable work.

LineGrouping.description: How the document folds tracked time into its line table. Presentation only: the stored lines stay one per entry. `single` = one row for the period, `project` = one row per project, `task` = one row per project and task, `line` = one row per time entry. Expenses and manual lines always keep their own rows.

original_amount_minor.description: The amount as entered, in `original_currency`, when the expense was recorded in a currency other than the billed one. `amount_minor`/`currency` stay the billed pair an invoice snapshots.

original_currency.description: The currency the amount was entered in. Never equal to `currency`: an expense already billed in its own currency carries no conversion at all.

exchange_rate.description: The applied `original_currency` to `currency` rate as a decimal string (greater than zero, at most 1000000, at most 6 decimals) - money never rides on a float.

exchange_rate_date.description: The reference date the rate was published for (for example the ECB table's date), never the expense date.

original_amount_minor.description: The amount as entered, in `original_currency`. Set together with `original_currency` and `exchange_rate`; `amount_minor` is the billed amount and stays authoritative.

original_currency.description: The currency the amount was entered in (ISO-4217). Must differ from `currency`, and must be accompanied by `original_amount_minor` and `exchange_rate`.

exchange_rate.description: The `original_currency` to `currency` rate as a decimal string (greater than zero, at most 1000000, at most 6 decimals). Trailing zeros are insignificant and dropped; money never rides on a float.

exchange_rate_date.description: The reference date the rate applies to (for example the ECB table's date), as YYYY-MM-DD, never the expense date.

PdfHint.description: Metadata for the PDF archived beside the invoice.

PaymentTerms.description: Payment terms deciding the due date at issue.

days.description: Only for `custom` (then required); other kinds must omit it.

InvoiceTemplate.description: Org-wide invoice template (`invoice_template.json`). An install that never saved one resolves to the seeded defaults (subject `%customer_name% invoice for %period_month_padded% %period_year%` and `net_30`); an explicitly saved template is used as stored.

body.description: Markdown-subset body before the line table.

footer.description: Markdown-subset footer (e.g. bank details). Prints after the totals and before the notes section.

notes.description: Markdown-subset free text for the document's `Notes` section (supports %variables%). Prints under a `Notes` heading, after the footer and the customer's own notes, above the generated `Payment details` block.

InvoicePayment.description: One recorded payment on the invoice ledger.

InvoiceTimelineEventKind.description: Stable machine-readable timeline event kind. created/issued/updated/email_sent are emitted by Subtask A; sent (a manual mark-as-sent), paid (money received) and write_off by Subtask B. payment is reserved so a later subtask can add it without a contract change.

InvoiceTimelineEvent.description: One retained entry of an invoice's activity timeline (Subtask A), kept in the invoices/.timeline.<id>.json dot-file sidecar. A display aid, never a record of authority.

actor_name.description: Display name of the acting user; never a secret.

meta.description: Optional per-kind structured extras (e.g. the recipient + From identity for email_sent).

RecurMode.description: Bill tracked work or a fixed retainer.

active.description: false pauses generation; the billing cursor (last_period_end) is kept.

PaymentDetails.description: The company's payment details as configured for one customer (Get-paid panel, invoice emails, %payment_details%). Every part is optional free text; an all-blank block never persists. No provider integration exists by design — the client pays in on these details and settlement is recorded manually.

reference.description: What the payer should quote as the transfer reference.

rails.description: Structured currency-specific rails for multi-currency billing. The flat fields above stay authoritative for the single-rail case; nothing is migrated. Display data only — no payment provider is involved.

PaymentRail.description: One currency-specific payment rail (e.g. a EUR IBAN and a USD account). Display data only.

currency.description: ISO-4217 code, exactly three upper-case letters.

account_name.description: Account holder name as the bank knows it. Required: a blank value is a 422.

Address.description: Postal address parts, free text with length bounds.

country.description: Required (min 2 chars) when any address part is set.

Contact.description: Named person at a customer; at most one may be the billing contact.

OrgProfile.description: Company legal identity, stored as org_profile.json. Empty name falls back to the org_name config key.

legal_id.description: VAT / company registration id printed on documents.

from_name.description: Email sender display name; empty = built-in.

reply_to.description: Reply-To address; empty omits the header. Validated.

accent.description: Invoice document accent for the totals section; empty = ink-only.

legal_id_label.description: Display prefix for legal_id on documents (Tax ID, VAT, Company number). Empty keeps the built-in 'Tax ID' wording.

accountant_email.description: Accountant address offered when a paid invoice's PDF copy is sent. Empty asks each time. Validated as an email recipient.

ManualLineInput.description: A manual Product/Service line as submitted. Quantities are INTEGER hundredths (150 = 1.50) — the API never sees floats.

project_code.description: Optional link to a project of the invoice customer.

InvoiceLineInput.description: A draft line as submitted to PUT /api/invoices/{id}. Mirrors the stored InvoiceLine but is an INPUT shape: only kind and date are mandatory, the rest default. Manual lines (kind=fixed with an item kind) are re-priced server-side, so their amount_minor is always recomputed. Tracked lines (entry_id/expense_id) must be echoed back exactly as stored: any changed field is refused 422, which is how the rate snapshot stays immutable.

amount_minor.description: Not client-authoritative: recomputed server-side for manual lines and verified against the stored snapshot for tracked lines.

note.description: Optional for manual lines (the manual description); tracked lines carry the stored note verbatim.

quantity_hundredths.description: Manual lines: hundredths of a unit.

InvoiceEditInput.description: Draft edit or correction revision. Tracked lines must come back verbatim; manual amounts are recomputed server-side. status is only meaningful on a revision.

status.description: Reviewed status of a correction revision. Absent keeps the original status; draft returns the corrected document to a draft for reissue.

LabelOverrides.description: Display-label overrides for invoice documents. Empty = built-in label; API field names never change.

payment_heading.description: Heading of the generated payment block (default `Payment details`). Renames the block; it does not add free text — use the template `notes` field for that.

active.description: false = archived; hidden from new picks, history untouched.

Timer.description: A running timer for one user: server-side state, at most one active timer per user.

Retainer.description: Retainer aggregate; balance is ALWAYS the reconciled ledger.

BackupTimezone.description: The server process's local time zone. Scheduled backups are evaluated in it.

offset_minutes.description: Offset from UTC in minutes (positive east of Greenwich).

label.description: Fixed-width label such as UTC+02:00 or UTC.

abbreviation.description: Platform zone abbreviation (CEST), when the platform provides one.

BackupStatus.description: Backup schedule, the running app time zone, the next run and stored archives.

cadence.description: Weekly runs on Monday; monthly on the 1st.

time.description: Wall-clock time in the server local zone.

next_run.description: Null while scheduled backups are disabled.

next_run_local.description: The next run as a wall-clock label in the server's local time zone (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM), or null while disabled.

CsrfForbidden.description: CSRF header missing or wrong on a mutating request: send X-CSRF-Protection: 1.

ValidationError.description: Payload failed validation before any write or side effect.

Conflict.description: The operation conflicts with existing state: a duplicate name/code, a record still referenced, or a full collection (codes conflict / collection_full).

CollectionFull.description: The target collection has reached its configured document limit (code collection_full, TUCANO_MAX_DOCS). Nothing was written; the collection stays readable, so delete unused records and retry.

BadRequest.description: Malformed query, malformed path parameter or malformed body. The body is always the shared Error shape (codes bad_request / validation_failed); extractor or parser internals are never quoted.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeded the transport limit (code payload_too_large). Nothing past the limit was read, no handler ran and nothing was persisted. The limit itself is not echoed.

Locked.description: Transient lock condition; retry shortly. Sent with Retry-After. A concurrent writer holds the store lock (code write_lock_busy) or an entry's lock state could not be verified and the write was refused fail-closed (code lock_unavailable).

Unauthorized.description: No valid session cookie, or an invalid/expired one. Guarded operations require authentication; the body is the shared Error shape with code unauthenticated.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but the request is refused: an administrator role is required (code forbidden), the X-CSRF-Protection: 1 header is missing on a mutating request (code csrf), the first-run setup has already been completed (code initialised), or the account is deactivated (code inactive).

RateLimited.description: Too many failed attempts within the window (code rate_limited); retry once the window elapses or a successful attempt resets the key.

BadGateway.description: An upstream dependency failed (codes calendar_fetch, email_failed, oauth_exchange); local state is unchanged and the operation may be retried.

VaultUnavailable.description: The secret vault is not enabled or not configured (codes vault_disabled, no_vault); integration credentials and features are unavailable.

FxUnavailable.description: No exchange-rate reference table could be loaded - offline, an unreadable TUCANO_FX_RATES_FILE, or a document that does not parse. Fail-closed: the rate is never guessed (code fx_unavailable), so the caller can enter one by hand.

InternalError.description: Server-side failure. The body stays generic and never carries paths, stack traces or raw filesystem errors. Codes: internal (unexpected), data_dir_invalid (a data path that must be a directory is not one), data_dir_not_writable (the filesystem refused a write: permissions or a read-only mount) and corrupt_document (a stored document did not decode; the file and parse error are in the server log).

CsrfProtection.name: X-CSRF-Protection
CsrfProtection.description: CSRF guard: mutating requests (POST/PUT/DELETE) must send this header with the literal value 1, otherwise the request is rejected 403 csrf. Exempt endpoints (no header required): POST /api/auth/login, /api/auth/bootstrap, /api/auth/sso/assertion.

DateParam.name: date
DateParam.description: Single day, YYYY-MM-DD. Exactly one of date or from+to.

FromParam.name: from
FromParam.description: Inclusive start of a range. A range query needs both from and to: the range-only endpoints answer 400 when either is absent. A span of at most 400 inclusive days is accepted (from=2025-01-01&to=2026-02-04); a wider one is refused.

ToParam.name: to
ToParam.description: Inclusive end of a range. A range query needs both from and to: the range-only endpoints answer 400 when either is absent.

OptionalFromParam.name: from
OptionalFromParam.description: Optional inclusive start of a range filter; pairs with to.

OptionalToParam.name: to
OptionalToParam.description: Optional inclusive end of a range filter; pairs with from.

LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Page size. Between 1 and 1000; anything else — including a larger value — is refused with 422 naming `limit`, never clamped, so a truncated page can never be mistaken for the whole set. The default is 200.

CursorParam.name: cursor
CursorParam.description: Opaque keyset cursor. Send back the previous page's `next_cursor` verbatim to continue the walk; never parse or construct one — its contents are an implementation detail. A value this service did not issue is refused with 422 naming `cursor`, never treated as a fresh first page.

get.summary: Exchange rate for one currency pair
get.description: The rate to convert `from` into `to`, taken from the ECB's published daily reference rates (EUR-based, no key). Both codes are ISO-4217 and matched case-insensitively. The rate is always served with the reference date it was published for, so a caller can judge its freshness; a currency converted with itself is the identity, needs no table and therefore also works offline. Fail-closed: when no reference table can be loaded the endpoint answers 503 fx_unavailable instead of inventing a rate, and the GUI falls back to a hand-entered rate.

200.description: The requested conversion. `date` is the reference date the rate was published for, or null when both codes name the same currency (the identity needs no published table).

rate.description: Units of `to` per one unit of `from`.

409.description: The period has nothing billable left or mixes currencies (code conflict), or the invoices collection is full (code collection_full). Nothing is persisted.

get.summary: Fetch one invoice

delete.summary: Delete an invoice in any status
delete.description: Removes the document, its archived PDF (an imported original included), its payment ledger and its timeline sidecar in one writer-locked write, clears the opposite revision link and records the deletion in the audit log. A deleted non-draft invoice releases the entries and expenses it locked.

put.summary: Edit a draft invoice: replace lines and percentages
put.description: Draft-only (409 otherwise); tracked lines are immutable rate snapshots; validation failures persist nothing.

post.summary: Create a correction revision of a sent or imported invoice
post.description: The revision keeps the original number, gets its own id and archived PDF, and may carry a manually reviewed status (including draft, so it can be corrected and issued again). The original document and PDF stay untouched as history.

post.summary: Issue a draft invoice (locks entries; archives the PDF)

409.description: The invoice is not a draft (code conflict), or the draft no longer matches the current timesheet (code draft_out_of_date: an entry on it was edited or deleted after the draft was generated). Nothing is issued in either case: regenerate the draft from the period and issue again.

get.summary: Download the archived invoice PDF; admin only
get.description: Returns the PDF archived at issue time, unmodified. A legacy issued invoice without an archive renders it from the snapshot-locked document on first read. Drafts are refused (409). Responses carry Content-Disposition and an ETag from the archive sha256.

ETag.description: SHA-256 of the archived bytes, quoted.

get.summary: On-demand, stage-stamped invoice PDF preview (Subtask C); admin only
get.description: Renders the invoice on demand and stamps it with the current watermark stage: DRAFT (a draft, or an issued invoice never delivered), SENT (a manual `sent` or an `email_sent` timeline event) or PAID (paid or partly paid), in that precedence (Paid > Sent > Draft). Unlike GET /api/invoices/{id}/pdf, which serves the frozen issue-time archive and refuses a draft with 409, this route always renders live, so **a draft is a normal 200**. The render is computed and never archived: it does not disturb the write-once invoices/<id>.pdf. The stage text is deliberately date-free, so the render is deterministic and the response carries an ETag.

200.description: Rendered PDF document carrying the current stage stamp.

ETag.description: SHA-256 of the rendered bytes, quoted.

post.summary: Email an issued invoice to the customer's billing address, or to an explicit recipient list
post.description: Admin only. The body is optional: without it (or with an empty `recipients` list) the invoice goes to the customer's single billing address. An explicit list is used in the given order, de-duplicated case-insensitively, validated before anything is sent (one '@', no control characters, at most 320 characters each, at most 10 recipients), and recorded on the invoice timeline. Drafts are refused with 409; a missing billing email with 422. Customer attachments have no application preview watermark. New issued archives are unstamped; a legacy archive with the known application stamp yields an in-memory clean delivery copy without modifying the archived file. This does not change the stage-stamped preview endpoint.

recipients.description: Explicit recipients. Absent or empty keeps the customer's billing address.

include_receipts.description: Attach the stored receipt files of this invoice's expense lines. At most 20 files and 25 MB in total; malformed receipts are refused before sending.

recipients.description: The resolved recipients, in delivery order.

transport.description: Delivery path. "disabled" = logged, NOT sent (no smtp.host configured).

receipt_count.description: Expense receipt files actually attached (0 when the option was off or no receipt was stored).

post.summary: Email a PDF copy of an issued invoice to a third party, e.g. the accountant
post.description: Admin only. Drafts are not shared (409). The recipient is validated before anything is sent or persisted; the send is recorded in the audit log with the recipient address and the invoice id, never the document bytes. The cover note names the requesting user.

note.description: Optional note in the cover email (max 2000 characters).

transport.description: Delivery path. "disabled" = logged, NOT sent (no smtp.host configured).

post.description: amount_minor absent = the full remaining balance (legacy behaviour). 0 is a 422, over-balance a 409 — both without persistence. Settling the last cent flips to paid; anything less parks at partly_paid with a ledger entry.

put.description: An edit replaces the record the way the entries PUT does: a field the payload omits is cleared. The record keeps its id, its author and its creation time, and `updated_at` moves. An expense frozen by an issued invoice (any non-draft status — invoiced records are permanent) or by a submitted/approved claim is refused with 409, and an unverifiable lock state with 503.

Effective externalised configuration: whitelist of non-secret knobs with value, source (env/file/default), default and writability
get.description: `vault_enabled` (boolean) is listed read-only (`writable: false`): it controls whether the credential vault starts on the next boot, but it is written only through `POST /api/admin/vault/enable|disable`, never through `PUT /api/admin/config` (a stored `false` next to a `secrets.bin` would make the next boot fail closed).

writable.description: Whether `PUT /api/admin/config` may change this key. Read-only knobs are written by their dedicated endpoint.

put.summary: Patch whitelisted keys into <data>/config.json; unknown, secret-shaped and read-only keys are refused
put.description: Unknown or secret-shaped keys are 422 `validation_failed`. So is `vault_enabled`: the dedicated lifecycle endpoints (`POST /api/admin/vault/enable|disable`) are its only writer (M3).

get.summary: Effective SMTP delivery settings; the password is never returned, only has_password

200.description: Resolved settings. `configured` is true only when an SMTP host resolves; `transport` mirrors it.

has_password.description: Whether a password is stored. The value itself is never serialised.

put.summary: Validate and store SMTP settings as vault keys; the next send picks them up without a restart
put.description: Writes smtp.host, smtp.port and, when supplied, smtp.username/smtp.password/smtp.from as one encrypted vault write. Omitted optional fields keep their stored value, so editing settings without a password never wipes it. With the vault disabled this answers 503 vault_disabled and mutates nothing; an invalid field answers 422 and mutates nothing.

host.description: SMTP hostname or address; no spaces or control characters.

username.description: Optional; omitted keeps the stored username.

password.description: Write-only. Omitted keeps the stored password; never returned.

from.description: Optional envelope sender; omitted keeps the stored value.

200.description: Stored; returns the same shape as GET.

has_password.description: Whether a password is stored. The value itself is never serialised.

post.summary: Send one short test message through the currently resolved transport

to.description: Recipient address, validated like invoice recipients.

200.description: Test message handed to the transport.

422.description: `to` is invalid (validation_failed) or no SMTP host is resolvable (email_not_configured). Nothing is sent.

get.summary: Credential-vault status: enabled/source/fingerprint and the actions currently allowed (admin only)
get.description: Always 200, even when the vault is disabled, so Settings can render the disabled state. The body never contains the master key, a key path or any host path; `key_file_name` is the literal `vault.key`.

post.summary: Enable the credential vault: resolve an env key, reuse vault.key, or generate one (admin only)
post.description: Resolves the key (env, env file, existing vault.key, else a newly generated 192-bit key written 0600), persists `vault_enabled=true`, then installs the live vault. 201 when a new key file was minted (`created_key: true`), 200 when an existing key was reused (`created_key: false`).

200.description: Vault enabled with an existing key (`created_key: false`).

201.description: Vault enabled with a newly minted key (`created_key: true`).

409.description: vault_already_enabled, or vault_managed_externally when the lifecycle is operator-managed (`TUCANO_VAULT_ENABLED` carries a valid boolean, or an env key/env key file is configured).

post.summary: Disable the credential vault and delete the generated key (admin only)
post.description: Requires `{ "confirm": true }`. Refused with vault_in_use while any secret is stored, and with vault_managed_externally when the lifecycle is operator-managed (`TUCANO_VAULT_ENABLED` or an env key/env key file). On success `vault_enabled=false` is persisted first, the disabled state is installed, and the managed vault.key is then deleted best-effort — a persistence failure returns 500 and leaves both the slot and the key untouched.

409.description: vault_in_use while credentials exist, or vault_managed_externally when the lifecycle is operator-managed through the environment.

post.summary: Replace the managed vault key with a fresh one (admin only)
post.description: Requires `{ "confirm": true }`. Refused with vault_in_use while any secret is stored and with vault_managed_externally when the lifecycle is operator-managed (`TUCANO_VAULT_ENABLED` or an env key/env key file). Answers 200 with a new fingerprint and `created_key: true`.

200.description: A new key file is installed (`created_key: true`, new fingerprint).

409.description: vault_in_use while credentials exist, or vault_managed_externally when the lifecycle is operator-managed through the environment.

put.description: Fail-loud validation: unknown %variables%, oversized fields and malformed payment terms return the standard 422 shape and persist nothing.

post.summary: Preview an unsaved invoice template as a PDF; admin only
post.description: Renders the CANDIDATE template from the request body against the shared sample invoice, the saved org profile (branding/accent/sender) and the sample customer's payment details, returning the PDF inline. Validates exactly like PUT (unknown %variables%, oversized fields, control characters in the subject, malformed payment terms) with the same 422 shape and persists nothing: no template, invoice, PDF archive or timeline entry. A command on existing configuration, so 200. The ETag is keyed on the inputs (canonical candidate template + resolved org + renderer/sample version), so a matching If-None-Match (including `*` and comma-separated lists) is answered 304 with no body before any render; the same ETag is returned on both responses.

200.description: Rendered preview PDF of the candidate template.

ETag.description: SHA-256 of the preview inputs (candidate template + resolved org + renderer/sample version), quoted.

304.description: Not modified: If-None-Match matched the input-keyed ETag, so no PDF was rendered and the body is empty. The same ETag is returned.

ETag.description: The same input-keyed ETag as the 200 response.

get.summary: Live {subject, html} preview of an invoice document
get.description: Resolved from the CURRENT template + customer (not a snapshot); the same content the PDF renders from. HTML is escaped markdown-subset output.

get.summary: Expense receipt files available to attach to the invoice email
get.description: Admin only. Returns one entry per distinct expense line on the invoice that has a stored receipt. Names only — the bytes stay on the server. Used by the email recipient dialog to offer the include-receipts option.

get.summary: Per-invoice activity timeline (Subtask A); admin only
get.description: Returns { events: [...] } newest first. Events are recorded when an invoice is created (tracked or manual), issued, edited as a draft, emailed to the customer, manually marked as sent, paid or partly paid, and written off. Unknown invoice ids are 404. The timeline is a display aid stored in a dot-file sidecar: a missing one is an empty list, and no event ever changes invoice status or billing state. It is the single source of truth for whether an invoice counts as sent (the `sent`/`email_sent` kinds); `paid`/`write_off` merely retain the settlement history next to the audit log.

post.summary: Mark an issued invoice as sent (Subtask B); idempotent
post.description: Records the manual delivery transition as a `sent` timeline event and returns the derived `sent_at`. `sent_at` is the earliest delivery on file: the event just recorded, or an earlier `email_sent` (an email send marks the invoice sent automatically). It is derived from the timeline and deliberately NOT a field of the Invoice schema, so the closed schema stays closed. A draft is 409, because nothing has been delivered and a draft has no archived PDF. Re-marking an already-delivered invoice is a 200 carrying the earliest delivery timestamp, with no duplicate event appended. Recording history never changes invoice status, locking or billing.

200.description: The invoice's delivery state after the transition (idempotent).

sent_at.description: Earliest delivery timestamp (RFC 3339): the `sent` event just recorded, or an earlier `email_sent`.

post.summary: Forgive the remaining balance of an open invoice
post.description: Admin only. Issued or partly-paid invoices become written_off (final); the ledger and paid amounts stay. Draft/paid/written-off states are 409; a missing/blank reason is 422 without persistence. Audit records invoice_write_off.

reason.description: Why the remaining balance is forgiven.
